name: Account use inconsistent with prior low-risk behaviour
description: Dormant or low-activity account abruptly receives or sends large volumes in a pattern tied to publicised ransomware campaigns.
fp: May have innocent explanations; assess in context of customer profile and other indicators.

sources.text: FinCEN, Advisory on Ransomware and the Use of the Financial System to Facilitate Ransom Payments (FIN-2021-A004, 2021)
FATF, Virtual Assets: Red Flag Indicators of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (2020)
